import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import runpy
import sys
from types import SimpleNamespace

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
L = runpy.run_path(str(ROOT / 'benchmarks/lto'), run_name='lto_helpers')
B = L['BENCH']
FROZEN = ROOT / 'build/runtime-v3/lto-frozen.json'
OUTPUT = ROOT / 'benchmarks/results/2026-10-09-runtime-v3-lto.json'


def build():
    L['validate_environment']()
    L['BUILD'].mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    B['verify_corpus']()
    chez = B['chez_runtime'](SimpleNamespace(snail_only=False, chez=os.environ['CHEZ']))
    report = {**L['provenance'](), 'chez': chez, 'builds': [], 'samples': [], 'summaries': [],
              'complete': False, 'phase_driver': Path(__file__).read_text()}
    groups = {name: L['build_program'](name, ('native', 'wasm'), chez, report['builds'])
              for name in ('cpu', 'memory')}
    if report['source_sha256'] != L['ABLATE']['source_state']():
        raise RuntimeError('sources changed during LTO builds')
    saved = {name: {target: [{'implementation': x.implementation, 'target': x.target,
                             'path': str(x.path), 'command': list(x.command)} for x in group]
                    for target, group in targets.items()} for name, targets in groups.items()}
    FROZEN.write_text(json.dumps({'report': report, 'groups': saved}, indent=2) + '\n')
    print('LTO FROZEN', FROZEN, flush=True)


def measure():
    saved = json.loads(FROZEN.read_text())
    groups = {name: {target: [B['Executable'](x['implementation'], x['target'], Path(x['path']),
                                             tuple(x['command'])) for x in group]
                    for target, group in targets.items()} for name, targets in saved['groups'].items()}
    arguments = SimpleNamespace(samples=4, json=OUTPUT)
    L['measure_programs'](groups, arguments, saved['report'])
    saved['report']['complete'] = True
    L['save_report'](OUTPUT, saved['report'])


(build if sys.argv[1] == 'build' else measure)()
